rules.title: 1:1 briefs are preparation aids
rules.statement: Use 1:1 briefs to prepare conversations, never as performance evidence or for pay and promotion decisions.

source.quote: Briefs prepare a conversation; they are never performance evidence

rules.title: Reports see the same evidence
rules.statement: Share brief sources with the report and invite their context before the 1:1.

source.quote: the report sees the same evidence

rules.title: Design approvals need a staff engineer
rules.statement: Managers do not approve high-tier designs on behalf of a staff engineer.

source.quote: High-risk designs are approved by a staff engineer
